blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two public high schools have been selected to join the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean)-Australia Building Relationships through Intercultural Dialogue and Growing Engagement (BRIDGE) Program. According to the Australian Embassy Manila, Batasan Hills National High School in Quezon City was partnered with Reece High School in Tasmania, Australia for the exchange
